scope: One bounded correction of the runtime02 root-URL binding failure; no modeling or Native campaign.

correction.implementation: One strict canonical-root helper reused by protocol construction and current endpoint binding; retain nonredirecting clients.
correction.equivalence: Supported HTTP(S) origin root with no trailing slash or exactly one trailing slash.
correction.refusals: Userinfo including empty userinfo, query or fragment including empty markers, non-root paths, unsupported/relative URLs, whitespace/control-bearing URLs, and changed origin.
correction.unchanged: Identity/source/clock/deadline/CAS/ledger/permit guards, existing CLI integration, default-OFF behavior, pending and command-count persistence.

validation.runner: One unittest discovery invocation limited to test_nominal_runtime.py.
validation.environment: unset PYTHONPATH, threads=1, no bytecode, no pytest autoload/cache, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, nice -n19, -B
validation.on_failure: Retain exact sources, all failures and cleanup receipts; stop without another generation or retry.

handoff: Source copies, before/after pins and exact source diff
Executable CLI interface, exact commands, raw logs and per-control artifacts
Current result and immutable predecessor-failure linkage
Structured limitations, REPORT.json, SHA256SUMS and seal receipt

qualification_limits.Native14: Rejected; not requalified by this runtime.
qualification_limits.B: Requires at least two consecutive real observe/predict/plan/actual-first-action-apply/reobserve cycles and actual admission-behavior change evidence. MockTransport and cap ACKs do not satisfy this.
qualification_limits.authority: No real approval artifact; experimental flag remains default OFF with separate scoped permit required.
qualification_limits.prohibited: No agents, broadcasts, model changes, Git, SDK/product/peer edits, network, SSH, GPU, rentals, installs, Eval access, workload regeneration or large tapes.
qualification_limits.ownership: Runtime journal lock and CPU test clients/known helpers only; no universal campaign, engine or service cleanup claim.
